title: GodScar: 3D Model Furnace Drake
author: irbrandonl
selftext:
Hey everyone! Back with another development update for GODSCAR, my dark fantasy turn-based RPG!

This time, I wanted to show off something a little bigger and get some feedback from you guys!

First off, I want to say I really appreciate all the feedback I've been getting on my previous posts. A lot of your suggestions and constructive criticism have genuinely helped me improve different aspects of the game and refine my development process.

Today, I'm showing off the Furnace Drake, one of several colossal bosses you'll encounter throughout GODSCAR!

One thing I've been experimenting with is making all of the game's colossal bosses fully 3D, while still keeping them visually consistent with the rest of the game's art style. The Furnace Drake is one of several bosses whose 3D models and animations I've been developing entirely with Claude Opus 5.5.

My goal is to make these encounters feel massive and intimidating, with attacks that really convey the weight, strength, and destructive power of the creatures you're fighting.

Of course, everything is still a work in progress, and there's always room for improvement!

I'd really love to hear your thoughts on this one!

What do you think of the Furnace Drake's model, movement, attack animations, and overall visual presentation? Does it feel like a colossal boss? Are there any particular animations or details you'd improve?

Don't hold back on the constructive criticism. That's exactly what I'm looking for!

Thanks again to everyone who's been following along and helping shape GODSCAR as development continues!

Developed with Claude Opus 5.5 (Extra Effort)
